title: Lemon Herb Salmon with Baby Potatoes and Beans
desc: Oven-baked salmon with lemon and herbs, crispy baby potatoes and green beans. One tray, mostly hands off.

portions.J: 200 g salmon (a large fillet), 250 g potatoes, 125 g beans
portions.P: 130 g salmon (a regular fillet), 150 g potatoes, 100 g beans

ingredients.name: fresh dill or parsley, chopped
ingredients.food: fresh herbs (dill, mint, parsley or chives)

steps.title: Potatoes in
steps.text: Oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with the oil, salt and pepper on a lined tray and roast.

steps.title: Season the salmon
steps.text: Mix the lemon zest, crushed garlic and herbs. Pat the salmon dry and press the mix on top.

steps.title: Salmon and beans in
steps.text: Push the potatoes to the sides. Add the salmon skin side down, lay lemon slices around, and scatter the beans. Roast until the salmon just flakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Squeeze some of the roasted lemon over everything.

notes: Salmon is higher in fat than the other dinners, but it's mostly omega 3. Pull it when the centre is still slightly translucent; it finishes on the plate.
